prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single objectively “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need creative/brand work, digital/demand-gen, PR, or a full-service partner.

A couple of widely recognized Kansas City options (good to know):
- Barkley — big, award‑winning creative and brand work; good for national campaigns and creative-driven branding.
- VML (and VMLY&R) — large integrated/digital capabilities; good for data-driven, cross-channel work.

How to pick the best agency for you
- Define the outcome: brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce growth, PR, etc.
- Match specialties: creative vs. performance marketing vs. PR/B2B.
- Check experience in your industry and look for relevant case studies.
- Size/capacity fit: boutique agency vs. agency that can scale to national work.
- Measurement and reporting — how they define and prove ROI.
- Client roster, references and retention rates.
- Budget and contract flexibility (pilot project option is useful).

Where to find and compare local agencies
- Review sites and directories: Clutch, UpCity, G2.
- Local coverage: Kansas City Business Journal, AAF Kansas City.
- LinkedIn — check teams, leadership, and client posts.
- Awards lists (ADDYs, Effies) and agency websites for case studies.

If you want, tell me:
- What industry you’re in
- Your primary marketing goal
- Monthly/annual budget range
- Timeline (immediate vs. long-term)

I’ll put together a targeted shortlist of 3–5 Kansas City agencies that fit your needs and a short outreach template or a ready-made RFP you can send. Which details can you share?
